entities.name: Ethyl ester saponification
observations: CCOC(=O)CH2N(Me)C(=O)C#CPh is converted to HOOCCH2N(Me)C(=O)C#CPh by ester hydrolysis.
The ester carbonyl–ethoxy bond is replaced by carbonyl–OH; the N-methyl and tertiary amide groups remain unchanged.

entities.name: NaOH MeOH H2O hydrolysis
observations: A directly supported reagent set is aqueous NaOH in methanol and water, followed by acidification as needed to isolate the free carboxylic acid.

entities.name: Sodium hydroxide
observations: Suitable base for saponification of the N-substituted ethyl ester in aqueous methanol/water.

entities.name: Methanol water
observations: Solvent mixture used with sodium hydroxide for the matched ester hydrolysis.

entities.name: Acidification workup
observations: Post-hydrolysis acidification may be used to convert the carboxylate salt into the free carboxylic acid product.
